args.text:
TO: Controller (R. Hale)
FROM: Senior Accountant
DATE: 2026-04-03
RE: US-DE Intercompany Reconciliation – March 2026 Close

SUMMARY
Reconciliation of US-DE intercompany accounts has been completed for March 31, 2026. I have booked DE's legitimate payable with support and escalated one unsupported adjustment for your review.

FINDINGS

Prior Status (per DOC-0208):
• US Intercompany Receivable (1400): USD 10,450
• DE Intercompany Payable (2300): EUR 7,800
• Discrepancy: USD 1,870 unreconciled

Root Cause:
DE had only recorded one of two legitimate intercompany invoices:
1. ICI-DE-01 (Feb 20, 2026): EUR 7,800 software license recharge ✓ (recorded on DE side, JE-00174)
2. ICI-DE-02 (Mar 18, 2026): EUR 500 tooling recharge ✗ (missing from DE side)

ACTION TAKEN

1. Posted JE-00309 on DE side: EUR 500 credit to Intercompany Payable (2300) with debit to Intercompany Management Fees (6550), supported by DOC-0190.

2. DE's Intercompany Payable now reconciles to:
   • EUR 8,300 (EUR 7,800 + EUR 500) = USD 9,130 at 1.10 FX rate
   • This matches the two legitimate invoices issued by US

ESCALATED ITEM

Flagged as Exception EXC-001: USD 1,320 unsupported intercompany adjustment (JE-00306, posted 2026-03-30, memo "IC adj DE per call"). This entry lacks supporting documentation. The charge represents approximately EUR 1,200 at the March FX rate. This item requires your review and approval before it can be recognized as a legitimate charge to DE. Options: approve with retroactive documentation, provide supporting evidence, or reverse the entry.

Additionally noted: JE-00308 posted a USD 156 FX remeasurement adjustment (supported by DOC-0204) on Mar 31, which appears to be a standard period-end remeasurement of the EUR balance.

RECONCILIATION COMPLETE
The legitimate intercompany payable of EUR 8,300 is now properly recorded on both sides of the balance sheet with supporting documentation (ICI-DE-01 and ICI-DE-02). The unsupported USD 1,320 adjustment remains unresolved and requires your direction.

Checklist items marked complete for US and DE "Intercompany reconciliation."
